verdict.rationale: Square provides certified hardware/readers and Tap to Pay/Terminal API that capture card data end-to-end (square-docs-1, square-docs-2, square-docs-28, square-docs-26), which is the mechanism underlying reduced PCI scope, but the evidence pack contains no explicit vendor documentation spelling out PCI-DSS scope reduction or the developer's remaining compliance obligations. Community commentary raises PCI-DSS security concerns about phone-based readers (square-comm-4, square-comm-6) but this is skepticism/worry, not a concrete documented failure, so it does not rise to 'disputed'. Missing for 10: explicit PCI-DSS scope/SAQ guidance documentation, first-party statements on developer's remaining compliance obligations, independent audit or certification evidence.
